1.w: For the one directing. A Song. A Psalm. Shout to God, all the earth!

2.w: Sing forth the glory of His name; make glorious His praise!

3.w: Say to God, “How awesome [are] Your works! In the abundance of Your might, Your enemies feign obedience to You.

4.w: All the earth will bow down to You and will sing to You—they will sing praises [to] Your name.” Selah

5.w: Come and see the works of God, being fearsome [in] His dealing with the sons of man.

6.w: He turned the sea to dry land; through the river they passed over on foot. There we rejoiced in Him,

7.w: ruling in His might forever; His eyes keep watch on the nations; let those rebelling not lift themselves high. Selah

8.w: bless our God, O peoples, and make heard the voice of His praise—

9.w: the One putting our soul among the living and not having given our feet to slip.

10.w: For You have tested us, O God; You have refined us like the refining of silver.

11.w: You have brought us into a net; You have placed pressure on our backs.

12.w: You have caused man to ride over our heads; we came into the fire and into the water, and You brought us forth to a watered place.

13.w: I will come into your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill to You my vows,

14.w: for which my lips have opened, and my mouth has spoken in the distress for me.

15.w: Burnt offerings of fatlings I will offer to You, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer of bulls with goats. Selah

16.w: Come, listen, all who fear God, and I will recount what He has done for my soul.

17.w: With my mouth I called out to Him, and He was praised under my tongue.

18.w: If I had seen iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.

19.w: Surely God has heard; He has attended to the voice of my prayer.

20.w: Blessed [be] God, who has not turned aside my prayer, or His loving devotion from me.
